item.title: Urgent Request for Tree Pruning – Excessive Branch Growth Blocking My Sixth-Floor Window, Natural Light and View, 27th November
item.description:
Subject: Urgent Request for Significant Tree Pruning – Branches Blocking My Window and View I am contacting you to request urgent attention regarding a tree situated directly outside my home. I live on the sixth floor of the building, and the tree has grown excessively large and wide. Its branches are now extending extremely close to my window, almost touching the glass. The tree is severely obstructing my view and significantly reducing the natural daylight entering my home. I feel that I am being deprived of the enjoyment of my own living space because of the excessive growth of this tree. This situation is causing me considerable frustration and negatively affecting my psychological well-being. It is unreasonable to have branches growing so close to my sixth-floor window that they almost touch the glass. I would therefore like to request a proper inspection and substantial pruning of the tree. I am not asking for a minor trim. I want the branches to be cut back sufficiently to restore my view, allow natural light into my home and prevent them from reaching my window. I fully appreciate the importance of trees and protecting the environment. However, this should not come at the expense of residents’ quality of life, particularly when appropriate maintenance could resolve the problem. I would be grateful if you could take this matter seriously and arrange the necessary work as soon as possible. Please confirm whether this tree falls under your responsibility and what action can be taken. I look forward to your response and a satisfactory resolution. Kind regards

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 110, Vauxhall Bridge Road, Pimlico, City of Westminster
Report on FixMyStreet
